title: Black Light Physical Route Environment to Safety Certification Bridge
purpose: Prefer physically evaluated SI gravity/curvature state over proposed normalized route archetypes whenever authoritative mass/ephemeris inputs are supplied, while preserving a strict boundary between real environmental physics and fictional transit-family response.

sourceSelection.physicalSupplied: A supplied physicalEnvironmentContext MUST be resolved through blacklight-exo-ftl-curvature-environment-runtime.js.
sourceSelection.physicalReady: Use the physical packet after versioned dimensionless normalization.
sourceSelection.physicalPartial: Block certification as UNRESOLVED unless a later higher-authority policy explicitly permits the missing validity fields.
sourceSelection.physicalInvalid: Block certification as OUTSIDE_MODEL_VALIDITY. Do not fall back to a route archetype.
sourceSelection.physicalMissing: Only when no physicalEnvironmentContext is supplied may the route-safety runtime use its existing PROPOSED normalized route archetype.

normalizationProfile.purpose: Dimensionally lawful engineering normalization for combining unlike SI gravity/curvature terms before fictional family response is evaluated. Values are calibration references, not constants of nature or setting canon.

uncertaintyContract.rule: Missing uncertainty is not zero. A physical environment without bounded uncertainty may be physically computable but is not route-certification-ready.
uncertaintyContract.covarianceProxy: Until full covariance matrices are supplied, squared 1-sigma fractional terms are transported as nonnegative diagonal covariance proxies and labeled DERIVED.

physicalToSafetyMapping.familyBoundaryHazard: remains a fictional/operator-specific route-family term and is not derived from ordinary gravity alone

canonGuards: A physical SI packet constrains the fictional operator model; it does not prove the operator exists in real physics.
Do not add raw potential, acceleration, tidal and curvature values together before normalization because their dimensions differ.
Do not convert a supplied but invalid physical packet into a proposed archetype merely to keep a route selectable.
PARTIAL physical validity is not equivalent to zero risk.
The physical curvature diagnostic remains maximum single-source Schwarzschild-reference curvature unless a higher-fidelity multi-body relativistic model is supplied.
Family-boundary hazard remains operator-specific and may not be inferred solely from Newtonian/relativistic gravity metrics.
Normalization references are versioned PROPOSED engineering calibration, not physical constants.
Named race, manufacturer, vessel and installation limits remain higher authority within their documented scope.
